notes.title: Update note (4.1.9)
notes.notes:
Achievement will not reset after all true endings cleared.
 Fixed issues with "wmic" error and crashed.

notes.title: Update notice (4.1.5)
notes.notes:
Hi all! This is TeacherShiba.

I did not write any notes of several updates recently.
Most of them were minor issues, but I wrote a notice about some updates that you might need to know:


 Correcting some misspelled and fixed critical bugs
 If you reached a goal, now you can only reset endings without any reset of achievements.
 Fixed issues on Mac version caused by a secret achievement.


Thank you for playing this game even it does not support any other languages.
You can report me issues via e-mail, x(twitter) and discord.

E-mail : meeseeksyoung@gmail.com


[X(Twitter)]
[Drunken Kitten discord channel]

notes.title: Full Release at 20th June!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044047/3ee713e15f698326d58678dd9d434afb94abf0ee.png

Hi all,

Finally, we are getting out of early access and going to full release.
It has been a year and 2 months, what a long time.

Now we have a full-dubbed version with Korean voice actresses.

[previewyoutube=bc_8Qzig7k0;full][/previewyoutube]
This is a scene which was not dubbed. Now it has!

Official Release date is 20th June, 2021. (UTC+9)

If our result is better than we expect, we can expect to release in English, hopefully.
Thank you for your interest, even we still do not have an English version yet.
